claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_triggered_item_hazard
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an always-on deterministic hazard that damages qualifying creatures on touch and again at turn end while they hold or carry it. Existing magic-item families only cover passive grants, activated uses, and triggered reactions.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Pure Rebuke's failed-save branch removes the target entirely rather than dealing damage or applying a condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains.
